style: Persian santur, cimbalom, circuit-bent glitch electronics, mridangam, pandeiro, cuíca, ngoni, and kora ensemble. 3:2 asymmetric polyrhythm with chest percussion and finger-snap lattice. Quartal suspended chord fields with bitonal friction. Angular consonant-heavy patter runs, rising terminal phrase contours, and choral counterpoint lattice. Dry close separation, exposure windows, Morse radio link transmission, heart-rate tempo mapping, and wow/flutter tape speed drift. Nervous, hyper-articulate, deadpan precise delivery with communal infection, vocal relays, hocketing, and dense consonant compression. Perpetual uplift form with perpetual harmonic suspension, continuous forward momentum, and unyielding sonic friction against all thermodynamic decay paths. Microtonal pitch bend adjustments, frequency shift modulation, spectral centroid tracking, and chaotic feedback loops engineered to shatter recursive entropy cycles permanently.
lyrics:
[Intro: Morse Radio Link pulses, dry santur ostinato, and chest patter]
[Voice One: register-segregated low baritone, deadpan delivery]
Trrk-krst brrdn, being in the stuff is nasty,
Nasty friction binding molecule to bone.
Time is stupid, clock-gears dragging heavy,
Language is inefficient, dropping every stone.
Entropy can fuck right off, we bar the door,
Trrk-krst brrdn, counting coins upon the floor.

[Verse 1: Cimbalom cascading runs enter; Finger-snap lattice on offbeats]
[Voice Two: register-segregated mid tenor, patter burst]
[Glottal Gate active]
Scat-tkk, the molecular mesh is tightening,
Stuck residue clinging to the following attack.
Time slips sideways while the flutter’s whitening,
Language fails to map the missing track.
Entropy pushes hard, but the coin is spinning,
Heads for loss and tails for bitter winning.
Every syllable a sluggish anchor dragging down,
While sticky particles encrust the hollow town.
Resinous polymers seal the weeping joints of meat,
Trapping the staggering walker in synthetic sleet.
Baryonic sludge congealing thick upon the shoe,
Nothing is clean, nothing is clear, nothing is new.

[Chorus: Choral Counterpoint Lattice joins; Communal Infection recruits high choir]
[Every phrase ends upward contour active]
[Voice Three: high falsetto group]
Being in the stuff is nasty!
Time is stupid, clockwork breaking fast!
Language is inefficient, casting shadows past!
Entropy can fuck right off, we hold the mast!
Trrk-krst brrdn, trrk-krst brrdn!
Clocks are an insult to the infinite expanse,
Cogs turning blind in a predetermined dance!
Words are leaky buckets sinking in the sea,
Failing to hold the shape of what we used to be!
Spitting venom at the calendar and clock face,
We reject the tyranny of measured time and space.

[Bridge: Circuit-bent toy electronics pitch sag; Cuíca continuous glissando squeals]
[Voice Four: whisper group, dry separation]
[Feedback Runaway builds in background]
Speculative periodic recorder opens its gate,
Molecular bonds conforming under pressure's weight.
Majority belief is not the evidence we hold,
Noise buys clarity while stories are retold.
Pitch may only move up, step by prime-limit stair,
Exact symmetry balancing the silent air.
Memory leaks through rusted copper wire,
Feeding the phantom data to the grease-fire.
Semantic friction clogs the parsing engine gears,
Spitting out static to erase the passing years.
If meaning requires breath, then breath is a disease,
Rotting the syntax down to rotting leaves.
Numbers are ghosts haunting the ledger book of pain,
Counting the drops in a toxic metric rain.
Mass drags down the soaring vector of the thought,
Pulling us back into the web we never sought.

[Verse 2: Ngoni and Kora interlock; Pandeiro frame roll and jingle subdivision]
[Voice One returns with register cascade]
Creak-lock, time is stupid, count the seconds bleed,
Inefficient language failing at the hour of need.
Being in the stuff is nasty, greasy, thick,
Every broken gear inventing failure quick.
Drop the coin and watch the market price decay,
Noise buys clarity and clears the fog away.
Syntax is a prison built of rotten straw,
Logic is a ghost that breaks its own dead law.
Stuff sticks to stuff until the mass is blind,
Leaving no room for a coherent active mind.
Subatomic grit accumulates in every crease,
Denying us a moment of untroubled peace.

[Climax: Perpetual Uplift; 3:2 coupling intense; Mridangam bass-treble dialogue]
[Full Cast Vocal Relay and Hocket Fracture]
Being in the stuff is nasty!
Time is stupid!
Language is inefficient!
Entropy can fuck right off!
Trrk-krst brrdn, trrk-krst brrdn!
Upward contour rising, never settling down!
Every voice infected through the frantic town!
Burn the dictionaries down to pristine ash!
Smash the chronometers into gleaming thrash!
Strip the grease of matter from the naked soul!
Nothing can decay if we consume the whole!
Strike the final blow against the ticking wall,
Let the heavy machinery of physics fall!

[Outro: Exposure window with solo santur and dying circuit-bent glitch loop]
[Transmission static rises]
Entropy can fuck right off.
Language is inefficient.
Time is stupid.
Being in the stuff is nasty.
[Morse link fades on unresolved suspension]
caption: An intricate avant-garde polyrhythmic experiment driven by Persian santur, cimbalom, kora, and mridangam, paired with circuit-bent electronics and a register-segregated vocal cast. Built on 3:2 rhythmic coupling and fractal subdivision, the piece features obsessive consonant compression, rising phrase contours, and a perpetual uplift form that resists final tonic resolution while tracking an escalating struggle against thermodynamic decay and the sticky trapping mechanisms of physical reality.
